# Pull Request

## Summary

Describe what this PR changes and why.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Refactor
- [ ] Docs
- [ ] Build/CI

## Packages affected

List package(s) touched (e.g. `packages/sdk`, `packages/io-xlsx`, `packages/studio-mui`, `examples/studio-mui`).

## Verification

- [ ] `pnpm build` (root) passes
- [ ] `pnpm test` (or `pnpm test:node` / `pnpm test:jsdom`) passes for affected packages
- [ ] If behavior changed, tests were added/updated where appropriate

## Notes for maintainers

- Semantic releases are driven by **Conventional Commits** (see `config/release.config.ts`).
- Call out any breaking changes explicitly.
